subject: Future Tech
title: Large Language Models
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Large Language Models.

hook.text: GPT-4 passes the bar exam, writes code, and explains quantum physics.

buildup.text: LLMs predict the next word using patterns learned from trillions of words.

discovery.text: Emergent abilities appear at scale: reasoning, translation, math—skills nobody programmed.

twist.text: LLMs hallucinate facts, fail at basic logic puzzles, and can't learn from single examples.

climax.text: The debate: are LLMs the foundation of AGI needing more scale, or a dead end requiring fundamentally new approaches?

punchline.text: Impressive, flawed, and sparking the biggest debate in AI history.

quiz.question: What is a key limitation of large language models?
options: They hallucinate facts and fail at basic logic
They're too slow for real-time use
